matching_policy.split: frozen test split (2020-2025), no training-year storms used
matching_policy.time_zone: project timestamps are paired as UTC because their six-hour cycles coincide with ATCF UTC cycles
matching_policy.issue_cycle: exact (storm, issue hour) match, no interpolation across cycles
matching_policy.note: The model emits 6/12/18/24/30/36 h; the JTWC archive publishes 12/24/36/48/72/96/120 h with no 6 h record. The head-to-head table therefore uses 12/24/36 h, and the 6/18/30 h model leads are reported separately against best track only.
